messages.subject: For David Ricks | Healthcare investment, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Czapar,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. David A. Ricks, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Lilly's global growth and major manufacturing investments require disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and operating teams. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Lilly's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Eli Lilly and Company.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
